Kraken Parent Payward Plans to Offer Onchain Perpetual Futures to U.S. Clients, Starting with Hyperliquid

Payward, Kraken’s parent company, plans to offer onchain perpetual futures to U.S. clients, starting with Hyperliquid’s HIP-3 markets, subject to regulatory approval.

The markets would run on Hyperliquid’s public blockchain, with Payward’s CFTC-regulated Bitnomial handling deployment, clearing and settlement. NinjaTrader Clearing would carry client accounts, and trading would be limited to users approved and whitelisted by both entities. — link

UK FCA Releases Cryptoasset Regulatory Guidance, Authorization Applications to Open on Sept. 30

The UK’s FCA has released guidance on the scope of the country’s future cryptoasset regime. 

The regime will take effect on Oct. 25, 2027, with authorization applications opening on Sept. 30, 2026. The guidance covers qualifying stablecoin issuance, crypto trading platforms, dealing and arranging, custody, and staking services.

The FCA will consult on targeted updates in October following recent legislative changes. — link
